title: Read a plan
summary: plan describes proposed changes. It gives you a chance to review before choosing whether to apply.
introduction: plan describes proposed changes. It gives you a chance to review before choosing whether to apply. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: plan describes proposed changes. It gives you a chance to review before choosing whether to apply.
For the new local example, the plan proposes adding the terraform_data resource. It does not apply that change.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Find additions, changes and removals in the plan summary.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not approve a plan you have not read, especially one that removes resources.
For more detail later, use this [Terraform further reading](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/tutorials).

seo.title: Terraform: Read a plan
seo.description: Learn about read a plan in Terraform. Follow a small example, understand the result, and practise with a clear question.
